prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: APPROVAL-ONLY Rakky Ride RIDE DETAILS page, one tall portrait mobile screenshot proportional to390×844 logical pixels (9:19.5), straight-on, no device frame, no perspective, no comparison board.
Input1: ACTUAL public Google Maps screenshot crop, for the map BACKGROUND only. Reuse and crop/scale these real map pixels. Do NOT paint invented streets, imaginary routes or illustrated maps. Actual app will keep its live route, markers and dynamic location; this public backdrop does not represent the user's trip.
Input2: approved ride-selection style reference. Reuse its clean white/mint/green style and STANDARD generic sedan silhouette. Do not copy its full layout or large text.
Primary request: redesign ride DETAILS with the map still visible above a rounded bottom sheet, concise information and VERY COMPACT typography/icons. No application code will change until user approval.
IMPORTANT sizing at390 logical width: title15px maximum, ride name14px, fare15px, body13–14px, supporting text12–13px, action14px. Utility icon glyphs16–18px; car42px wide MAXIMUM. Controls48px touch areas even though icons are small. No oversized heavy headings, huge car artwork or decorative badges. Do not enlarge type to fill white space.
MAP: upper35–38% visible map. White circular back button top-left with small20px arrow. No route-summary overlay on this details page. No recenter button or new map control. Keep Google branding and "Map data ©2026 Google" visible along map bottom above sheet. Do not invent a driver ETA or fake vehicles.
BOTTOM SHEET: white,24px rounded top corners, small silver drag handle,16px horizontal padding. Fit content tightly, no large blank filler. Content can scroll in implementation; primary button pinned at bottom.
Header "Ride details" in15px semibold. Below it ONE compact ride/fare summary row: standard generic green side-profile sedan icon42px wide at left, text "Ride"14px with "Everyday rides"13px muted; at right "₦3,500"15px semibold and "Quoted fare"12px. No enormous image panel, no Recommended/Best value chips and no repeated standalone fare section.
Next, a quiet silver information block with TWO COLUMNS and TWO ROWS, light internal dividers and small16px outline icons: "Est. distance" / "12.5 km", "Est. trip time" / "28 min", "Vehicle" / "Economy", "Seats" / "4". Values13px, labels12px. Use road/distance, clock, small generic car and person icons. All numbers are illustrative; trip time is journey duration, NOT pickup/driver ETA.
Next a concise route-summary block with two aligned rows: small teal pickup circle and label "Pickup"12px, sample address "Allen Avenue, Ikeja"13px; small coral destination pin and label "Drop-off"12px, sample address "Ikeja City Mall, Alausa"13px. Tiny connecting vertical line, no second map and no new edit action here. Enough room for a real long address to wrap to two lines in implementation.
Next a full-width compact56px payment row, small18px banknote outline, "Cash"14px and "Pay after your trip"12px, small chevron16px at right. Opens existing cash/wallet chooser. No wallet balance is invented.
A quiet13px line "Arrival time appears after a driver accepts." No insurance, price guarantee, ratings or availability promise.
BOTTOM ACTION:48px forest-green rounded12px button, label14px exactly "Request Ride · ₦3,500". This opens the EXISTING confirmation step, not an immediate charge. Comfortable16px bottom safe area. Preserve all fare refresh, error, scheduled-trip, cash/wallet and booking rules in future implementation; no extra ride classes, features or action buttons.
Palette: white #FFFFFF, silver #EEF1EC, mint #EAF5E5, charcoal #141A14, muted #586253, green #176B17. Inter-style small readable typography, thin consistent outline icons, modest shadows, no gradients, no emoji, no large marketing imagery.
If space is tight, reduce gaps and allow two-line addresses; NEVER increase fonts. Keep the whole view compact and orderly. Small outside caption "Ride details • Design proposal • Sample values".

Use case: ui-mockup. Refine only this Rakky Ride Ride details approval mockup. Keep all content, sample numbers, actual map backdrop, clean palette and existing actions. Make the UI COMPACT:
- Reduce the green car illustration to HALF its present width, around42 logical pixels (about90 source pixels on this850px-wide image). It should be only about1.4 times as wide as the word Ride, not a hero image.
- EVERY functional metric/payment/location icon must be16–18 logical pixels, about the same height as a line of its adjacent small text. Shrink current road, clock, vehicle, seats, pickup, destination and cash glyphs by about35%. Keep standard outline icon style.
- Ride details heading15px logical, around32 source pixels; reduce its current size and weight slightly. Ride/fare14–15px, supporting copy12–13px. No oversized text.
- Ride/fare summary row60px high maximum. Metrics2×2 block80px high, route-summary block90px high (addresses still readable and can wrap when implemented). Payment row56px and primary button48px.
- Tighten gaps to10–12px. Preserve16px side padding and bottom safe area.
Use the saved room to let the real map occupy the TOP36–38% of the phone screen, rather than the current29%. Move the white rounded sheet downward accordingly. Keep Google attribution above sheet. No extra map controls, route-summary overlays, badges or invented features. The bottom sheet remains scrollable in implementation with its request button pinned.
Keep the two-column metrics labels and values exactly, keep one quoted-fare display plus amount in action, and preserve the quiet arrival-time note. Standard generic car silhouette, not emoji or3D. This is an approval picture only.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this Ride details design. Make ONLY ONE change: RESTORE the small white circular BACK button at the upper-left of the MAP, about16 logical pixels inset from the top safe area and left edge. Use a48px touch circle containing a slim18–20px charcoal arrow pointing left. This is the existing back navigation and must remain. Keep EVERYTHING else unchanged: all map pixels and labels, sheet position, typography, car icon, metric rows, route summary, cash row, arrival note, request action and external sample-data caption. Do not resize or redesign anything else, do not remove content, do not add any other controls.
